0x00098A.en: 「Th-this is... as far as I go...!」

0x0009BC.en: 「At my level now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000A2D.en: 「Guh! This is as far as I go...!!」

0x000AB5.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000C16.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000CDF.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000D1A.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000D6E.en: 「Blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000E58.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000EBF.en: 「So this is it... The rest is up to you.」

0x000EF1.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this as far as I go!?」

0x000F6B.en: 「No good, we've taken too much damage... Pulling back!」

0x000FB8.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000FF6.en: 「Eeek! Please, I leave the rest to you!」

0x00103D.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x0010E8.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one falling like a shooting star... Bailing out!」

0x001224.en: 「Ngh...! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001291.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012D8.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00130D.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!?」

0x0013F9.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　How green I am...!」

0x001447.en: 「No good, this is my limit! Retreating!」

0x0014C0.en: 「Sorry!@　I'm gonna have to pull out...!」

0x001531.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00159E.en: 「This is my limit. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001629.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll be pulling back here...!」

0x00178F.en: 「Bailing out...@　Ngh...! Not very graceful of me...」

0x00184D.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A5F.en: 「No good, they've gone and got me.」

0x001A91.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001B0D.en: 「Captain, recovery of all units is complete.@　Also, Doctor Cliff, Dr. Wong and the others@　will remain behind to investigate the Cross Gate.」

0x001BDA.en: 「The Federation forces will arrive here shortly.@ Security here, though...」

0x001C75.en: 「We're receiving a transmission from Ganglong of Baral!」

0x001CCE.en: 「I doubt it's a message of congratulations.」

0x001D8E.en: 「What, tough crowd...@　We're happy over here, you know. All thanks to you@　sealing away the "King of Ruin."」

0x001E27.en: 「So, as our thanks,@　we've decided to invite you all to the Garden of Baral.」

0x001EB1.en: 「To reward you, of course. We'll throw a grand banquet.」

0x001EF4.en: 「And what's on the menu? The Four Fiends' Chokijin, JakuBuOh,@　the Yokijin, perhaps?」

0x001F81.en: 「I have no intention of ceasing to be human.」

0x001FB5.en: 「Well, let's meet in person and talk it over.@　I'll open the Gate of Baral, so do come.」

0x00204B.en: 「Just as the name says, an entrance leading to our abode...@　I'll open a little hole in the barrier.」

0x0020BC.en: 「But the invitation is for you alone.@　Bring anyone else along, and they'll all die.」

0x0021A7.en: 「We'll report to Lieutenant General Jacob Moore,@　and head for the Garden of Baral.」

0x002203.en: 「It spares us the trouble of breaking the barrier,@　but surely you realize it's a trap?」

0x002274.en: 「Still, as things stand,@　we're the only ones who can respond.」

0x0022D0.en: 「XO, begin constructing the rendezvous@　sequence with the Garden of Baral at once.@　I'll contact General Jacob and request resupply.」

0x0023B5.en: 「...Current altitude, 250 kilometers.@　Rendezvous sequence with the Garden of Baral@　shifting to Phase 3.」

0x002454.en: 「All hands to Condition One battle stations.」

0x0024A7.en: 「Any sign of the Gate of Baral opening?」

0x0024EA.en: 「No, not yet, it seems. Just in case, shall we@　ready the bow Super Graviton Cannon and the@　Tronium Buster Cannon for firing?」

0x002598.en: 「A preemptive strike the moment the Gate of Baral opens... is that it?」

0x0025E4.en: 「Rather rude of us, seeing as we were invited, but still.」

0x002624.en: 「The Garden of Baral withstood a direct hit from the H-MAPW,@ and given Ganglong's tone, a preemptive strike would likely be wasted.」

0x0026D8.en: 「So we've no choice but to be on the defensive...」

0x002718.en: 「...From here, the Earth looks blue, doesn't it.」

0x002795.en: 「"The Earth was yellow-green" just... doesn't have the same ring.@　It's gotta be blue.」

0x002803.en: 「Right.@　And for that, we've got to blow those Baral@　bastards away, no matter what.」

0x002891.en: 「I see... It was your first time.」

0x0028BC.en: 「I... Luina was trying@　to destroy that?」

0x002915.en: 「Seeing that blue radiance,@　something wells up in my chest... I can't describe it...@　What is this...?」

0x002990.en: 「That's... seeing something beautiful@　and being moved by it, isn't it?」

0x002A0E.en: 「You too, Glacies. If Shouko were a boy,@　she wouldn't leave you alone.」

0x002AAA.en: 「Yeah. Even as a girl, I look up to you.」

0x002ADB.en: 「A cool beauty in the literal sense.」

0x002B28.en: 「What you said before... 'wouldn't leave you alone,' what did you mean?」

0x002B74.en: 「It means a man like Irm@　would come sweet-talk you, Glacies.」

0x002BFB.en: 「Sorry, but I'm not so idle that I'd charge in@　where there's no chance.」

0x002C9E.en: 「Alright, enough idle chatter.@　We're at Condition One battle stations, so everyone,@　into your machines, into your machines.」

0x002D2F.en: 「Abnormal gravity reading detected in the airspace@　within a 20-kilometer radius of the ship!」

0x002D9A.en: 「Here it comes! Open all gun ports! Ready to attack!」

0x002DD4.en: 「Ah! High-energy reading at twelve o'clock!@　It-it's spreading!!」

0x002E49.en: 「W-we won't make it! We're being swallowed up!!」

0x002EBF.en: 「The same as that time... the Boundary Realm!」

0x002F3D.en: 「Welcome to the Boundary Realm, Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x002FAF.en: 「Correct. This is our first meeting in the flesh.@　First, let me offer my renewed thanks@　for sealing away the King of Ruin.」

0x003051.en: 「They were a troublesome foe for us as well.@　You've done us a great service.」

0x0030B9.en: 「Nice try!　@　You were content to sit back and watch from up high!」

0x003118.en: 「Not entirely.@　Had you fallen to the King of Ruin,@　I'd have marched on the South Pole myself.」

0x0031A5.en: 「Besides, it was we who wiped out the last of Ruina.@　I'd say a little gratitude is in order.」

0x003228.en: 「But you were still using us to buy time,@　weren't you?」

0x003284.en: 「Sharp as ever. The Earthly Utopia's framework is set,@ but the Grand Sublimation Plan still needs@ a bit more time before its final stage.」

0x003332.en: 「And how much longer would that be!?」

0x0033B3.en: 「No, make that five hours. Or maybe five days?@　Though certainly not five years.　@　Ahahahaha!」

0x00346E.en: 「Oh, that's right. There's one more bit@　of thanks I owe you.」

0x0034DC.en: 「Thank you for treating our priestess so kindly.」

0x003599.en: 「So it was you people who abducted her after all!!」

0x0035E5.en: 「Abducted, how rude.@　She's the priestess of the god of Baral... the key to the Grand Sublimation Plan.」

0x00368D.en: 「It's no lie.@　You know she has a 'power,'@　don't you?」

0x0036FC.en: 「Then Irui is connected to the Custodes...!」

0x00373F.en: 「There's no way that girl is one of Baral!@　Not that sweet child!」

0x0037D5.en: 「Then why did Irui stay with us...!?」

0x003818.en: 「Irui approaching us was all a setup...?」

0x003886.en: 「I-I won't believe it...!@　Even if it's true, they've twisted@　Irui's will to their own ends!」

0x00391F.en: 「If you truly want the truth, there are two ways.@　Sublimate in Baral's name and ascend to immortality...」

0x0039B1.en: 「Or strike you down and march into Baral's garden... right?」

0x0039FD.en: 「Yes.@　Kanan and Taihoku tried more than once to win you over,@　but you refused to lend an ear.」

0x003A81.en: 「Well, it's that very strength of will@　that let you turn back the King of Ruin...」

0x003AFE.en: 「To guard the Earthly Utopia and fight the myriad demons@　that appear seeking the path to Heaven, I want your power.」

0x003B9D.en: 「Don't be that way. Give up being human@　and let's all be happy together.」

0x003BF3.en: 「Sorry, but I was never human to begin with.」

0x003C21.en: 「Then let's live it up in the Earthly Utopia.@　Wine and women, as befits the earthly.」

0x003C9C.en: 「Wine and women in paradise...@　Hardly the words of an immortal sage.」

0x003D0B.en: 「Hah, so stubborn.@　And here I'm trying to open the door wide for you.」

0x003D64.en: 「Like my ancestor, I'll not lend an ear to your ravings.」

0x003DBA.en: 「My name is Rishu Togo.@　Surely the name Togo rings a bell.」

0x003E1C.en: 「Togo... ancestor...@　Ah, Ryuuma Inago? Or Shunma, perhaps?@　There was a Heima too, I believe.」

0x003EAF.en: 「Ah, such nostalgia. Wen Li, Fei Li,@　Jabez, Edward, Alyssa Grimms,@　Klaus Branstein...」

0x003F67.en: 「And V.B....@　She was a Branstein too, wasn't she.」

0x003FEE.en: 「Oh my, a descendant? How fateful.@　Or perhaps it's my lord's guidance?」

0x00405F.en: 「Well, no matter.@　The time is ripe... I'll break both@　your bodies and your hearts.」

0x0040CE.en: 「Oh, you may be able to come back even if you die,@　so no need to worry on that count.」

0x00412A.en: 「With respect, I've had quite enough near-death experiences.」

0x00416D.en: 「Kukuru, deal with them, would you?@　Once the deed is done, I'll free your family's souls.」

0x0041F9.en: 「...You'll not go back on your word?」

0x004227.en: 「Of course not. Well, I leave the rest to you.」

0x0042EB.en: 「It's no concern of yours.@　Any who defy my lord's will shall be sent to the underworld.」

0x004390.en: 「However many times you resist us, it's futile!」

0x00440E.en: 「Kukuru, you don't truly follow Baral@　from the bottom of your heart.@　Am I wrong?」

0x004486.en: 「I told you!　It's no concern of yours!」

0x0044CC.en: 「I see now why you follow Baral.」

0x00450C.en: 「You old fool!　Today you fall to the underworld!」

0x004552.en: 「Weren't you once fighting against Baral too!?@　Just like this RyuKoOh!」

0x0045D0.en: 「Silence!@　Even the Machine Gods of the Four Gods, if they defy@　Baral's god, fall to hell as demons!」

0x00465A.en: 「Don't tell me... your family is being held hostage!?」

0x00469D.en: 「It's no concern of yours!@　If you won't accept the fate of the Four Gods, then go to your grave!」

0x00470B.en: 「Serving Baral is no one's fate!@　The KoRyuOh says the same!」

0x0047C9.en: 「I-I cannot be destroyed!@　If I perish, my father and mother...!」

0x00489A.en: 「Well, I never expected much of you.@　Play one last role for me, at the end.」

0x004908.en: 「Defy us, and see what happens...@ As an example to the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ go get devoured by ToTetsuOh.」

0x0049C6.en: 「Ah, I acknowledge your service until now.@　So I'll send you to be with your parents.」

0x004A53.en: 「Yes, your precious family is inside ToTetsuOh's belly.」

0x004A93.en: 「Th-then!　The ice vessels in Baral's garden!?@　My father and mother inside them!?」

0x004AF5.en: 「Ah, those. Well-made funerary dolls, aren't they?」

0x004BD5.en: 「...Kukuru was deceived by Guang Long, it seems.」

0x004C1B.en: 「I-I... what have I been doing all this time...!?」

0x004CA2.en: 「So ToTetsuOh could devour you, right here!@ Goodbye! And good night!@ Ahahahaha!」

0x004DC9.en: 「What are you saying?@　That's the woman who tried to kill you over and over.」

0x004E28.en: 「And it was you who drove her to it.」

0x004E5C.en: 「Naive, so naive.@　But perhaps the priestess grew fond@　of exactly that side of you.」

0x004F0E.en: 「Well, no matter.@ Your next foes are the Machine Gods of the Four Fiends, ToTetsuOh and KyuKiOh.」

0x004F6A.en: 「As you know, they show no mercy.@　And a word of advice, if I may...」

0x004FE7.en: 「Get devoured by ToTetsuOh or KyuKiOh@ and there's no sublimation to speak of.@ Your soul is consumed, utterly erased.」

0x00506E.en: 「S-Son Ganglong...!@　I'll never forgive you!　You above all, never!!」

0x0050CA.en: 「You mean to turn your blade on us, Kukuru?@　You know well what that will bring, don't you?」

0x005170.en: 「If the lord's grace is cut off,@　your hollow soul is erased. You understand?」

0x0051F1.en: 「I am the priestess of the netherworld... I merely return where I belong.@ But you... all of you, I cannot forgive!」

0x005280.en: 「I will avenge my parents' bitter fate!」

0x0052BD.en: 「Oh, is that so.@　Then do your very best.」

0x005304.en: 「...Sanger Zonvolt,@　I offer you no thanks.」

0x005354.en: 「But here and now, I part ways with Baral@　and strike down those who deceived me!」

0x0053F3.en: 「Machine Gods of the Four Fiends... I won't lose to you!」

0x005433.en: 「Don't think you can stop us... the White Tiger and@　the Azure Dragon... so easily!!」

0x005568.en: 「Kusuha, let's pick up where we left off.@　I've come to break your heart.」

0x0055BE.en: 「That beings like you are the guardians of Earth...@　I can't accept it!」

0x005635.en: 「Sad to say, mere humans cannot drive off@　the myriad demons. Without raising the rank of your souls,@　you cannot achieve your true purpose.」

0x0056E0.en: 「That's not true!@　We turned back the King of Ruin too!!」

0x00573C.en: 「That was thanks to my lord's protection.」

0x005776.en: 「But it was you who sealed us on Earth.」

0x0057B0.en: 「You children may not understand...@　but to wipe away the calamity of the stars, that was best.@　Isn't that right, Guang Long?」

0x0058D9.en: 「Same as the RyuOhKi... a dragon Machine God...!?」

0x005913.en: 「Yes. Your RyuOhKi is the Azure Dragon Machine God...@　mine is the Responding Dragon Machine God.」

0x005997.en: 「So it is. The Yellow Dragon is divine. The@ Responding Dragon, chief of the Four Dragons,@ outranks Azure, Red, White, and Black Dragons.」

0x005A30.en: 「Oh, you there, quite knowledgeable.@　Yes, <Machine Gods> come in several ranks.」

0x005AAF.en: 「The Four Gods you know so well,@　the Four Fiends you just defeated...@　there were also the Four Sins.」

0x005B39.en: 「And my OhRyuKoh@　is a Machine God of the highest 'Four Sacred Beasts.'」

0x005BBD.en: 「Yes, the being that commands all Machine Gods,@　the guardian of the Earthly Utopia.」

0x005C1F.en: 「Though sadly... I can't show you@　the other Four Sacred Beast Machine Gods.」

0x005C90.en: 「Why not?@　Since we're here, I'd like a look.」

0x005CE3.en: 「Many reasons... but I needn't explain them to you.」

0x005D2F.en: 「Now then... let me show you a little of my power.」

0x005DF1.en: 「Oh yes, forgot to mention, I'm a strong Psychodriver too.@　It's a bother, so I usually keep it in check.」

0x005EB5.en: （Hmm, I see. Purely refined, is it?@　But unlike me, rather a lot of impurities, hm?）

0x005F4E.en: 「Now, I'll ask once more...@　Will you bow your heads quietly and come to us?」

0x005FC5.en: 「The same tired story, over and over...!」

0x006005.en: 「You aren't protectors of the human world,@　you're a threat to it!」

0x00605B.en: 「Well, you would say that.@　Then let me explain it all from the top again.@　Feel free to repair, resupply, and rest in the meantime.」

0x0060FA.en: 「Oh, and if you go to the toilet,@　keep it on this channel. Hahaha.」

0x006159.en: 「That guy, mocking us at every turn...!」

0x00619C.en: 「Now, as Kanan and Taihoku likely told you,@ it was none other than Baral's god and us@ who once saved this Earth from ruin.」

0x00625C.en: 「Long ago, demon gods and monsters ran rampant@ on this world... called the myriad demons,@ they threatened humanity and blighted nature.」

0x006310.en: 「Oh, and it seems one of those dregs stands right there.」

0x006353.en: 「And to oppose the myriad demons,@　the ancients created the Machine Gods...」

0x0063B2.en: 「And the one who commanded them was our lord,@　Earth's guardian deity, 'Gan Eden.'」

0x006454.en: 「So that's the name of Baral's god...!」

0x0064EE.en: （It's the same... the Cross Gate... and@　that word, "Gan Eden," too... why do I...?）

0x00655C.en: 「And I was chosen to take Gan Eden's place while@　it slumbers, and to be the guardian of this world.」

0x0065F7.en: 「I remember it vividly, even now.@　The Four Spirits, the Four Gods, and countless@　other Machine Gods gathered under the God of Baral, but...」

0x006690.en: 「Against all expectation, the tyrannical ones -@　the Four Sins, the Four Fiends, and their@　followers - sided with the Hundred Evils.」

0x006720.en: 「The result was the Demon Machines...@　In other words, the Machine Gods split into@　friend and foe, and went to war.」

0x0067A4.en: 「The fighting only grew fiercer... shattering the@　earth, parting the seas, scorching the very sky.@　Later they called it the Great Machine War.」

0x006858.en: 「That's how the legend got started - that the@　Machinery were demon gods who cursed the world.」

0x0068DB.en: 「Kusuha, Bullet... your Machinery were@　thought of the very same way, you know？」

0x006971.en: 「Yes. During the Great Machine War, the RyuKoOh@　and KoRyuOh betrayed Gan Eden and joined the@　Hundred Evils.」

0x0069F4.en: 「And to punish them, the JakuBuOh - a fellow@　Four Gods unit - gave chase.@　That's where their feud began.」

0x006A8D.en: 「But righteousness lies with the JakuBuOh.@　The RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh foolishly forgot@　their duty and were seduced by the Evils.」

0x006B35.en: 「Don't you lie!@　The KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh fought the Einst!」

0x006B91.en: 「And yet now they turn their blades on Gan Eden@　and on us, its servants...」

0x006BF6.en: 「One who defies a god can only be a devil, no？」

0x006C42.en: 「That's not true!@　The RyuKoOh is a guardian of the human world...！」

0x006CAA.en: 「That's how they fooled you. Drawing out their@　greatest power through human soul and will -@　that is their old, familiar trick.」

0x006D4C.en: 「The Machinery's destiny is not only to save@　mankind, but to annihilate all demons and evil...@　to destroy every threat to this world.」

0x006DF1.en: 「And you, who'd stand in the way of that, along with the RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - you ARE the Hundred Evils.」

0x006E68.en: 「No... words like those won't break us.@　The KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh have fought beside us@　time and again against this world's threats...」

0x006F28.en: 「Yes, the KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh are with us even@　now! If you were righteous, the true guardians@　of Earth, they wouldn't be standing here!!」

0x006FF2.en: 「I see, the White Tiger's pilot has a point. Good, good.」

0x007038.en: 「Come now, old man... don't go raining on my parade.」

0x0070A6.en: 「Guang Long, there's no use preaching further.@ Children must be guided by a firm scolding.」

0x00710E.en: 「Well, it always plays out about the same anyway.」

0x00714B.en: 「But this time is different.@　Beneath Gan Eden is the Mashiah.」

0x0071F4.en: 「Yes, that's right. With the Mashiah, Gan Eden@　unleashes its true power. The proof is the@　revived Garden of Baral and the barrier.」

0x007329.en: 「If you want the truth, ask her yourself.@　After you've been released from the flesh, that is.」

0x00739D.en: 「Well then, shall we begin？@　A second coming of the ancient Great Machine War!」

0x00740C.en: 「Yeah, I believe in the KoRyuOh and RyuKoOh!@　Just like I always have!」

0x007477.en: 「It's the God of Baral you should believe in.@　They say the faithful are saved, don't they？」

0x0074D9.en: 「I want no part of your salvation.」

0x00750A.en: 「There's no god I believe in - just this.」

0x007544.en: 「The bond of fate between House Togo and your@　kind - I'll sever it here and now.」

0x0075A6.en: 「If you're that set on it, maybe I'll get serious@　too？ And if you happen to die, don't you worry.」

0x007629.en: 「We'll guard the Earth in your place!@　Ahahahahahaha!!」

0x0076D3.en: 「I! We are the sword that cuts down the Hundred@　Evils!! Any who stand in our way - be they gods -@　shall be cut down!!」

0x00775D.en: 「Hahaha, so you call us the Hundred Evils!@　Then, OhRyuKoh! Grant these fools the lightning of judgment!」

0x0077DD.en: 「And send their souls down to the great@　God of Baral! Hahahaha!」

0x007842.en: 「Hm, this one may be a fierce fight.@　Best I mend the talisman-armor early.」

0x0078AD.en: 「Th-this is bad!@　If they pull that off, it's a war of attrition!!」

0x007900.en: 「Shennong, Flame Emperor, come and guard me.@ One stroke of this blade, every demon flees,@ every illness heals - so it is commanded.」

0x0079A6.en: 「What did you say...！？@　The BuJakuOh has no power to refuse our control...」

0x007A36.en: 「How can you be so calm about this!」

0x007A4F.en: 「What！？ You're not gonna pull your usual cheat！？」

0x007AAB.en: 「Either way, this is our lucky break!@　Now I can see a chance to win!」

0x007B10.en: 「Taihoku, still can't mend the armor all at once？」

0x007B53.en: 「No. The BuJakuOh seems to have its own thoughts.」

0x007B90.en: 「Is this the time for that! Let me take over!」

0x007C3F.en: 「Now, let's start over.@　The JakuBuOh and I will show you the path you must walk!」

0x007C9E.en: 「Hm, not bad at all.@　Best I mend the armor.」

0x007D1F.en: 「The BuJakuOh seems to have its own thoughts.」

0x007D53.en: 「Is this the time for that!@　Let me take over!」

0x007D9D.en: 「Now, let's start over.@　The JakuBuOh and I will show you the path you must walk!」

0x007DFC.en: 「Not bad at all...@　For commoners to push the JakuBuOh this far.」

0x007E5B.en: 「But you don't know what the Nanboku Immortals@　truly are. Taihoku, bind the BuJakuOh with the sorcery...」

0x007ECC.en: 「Kanan... no, Jun. Have you forgotten there is@　one thing alone we cannot defy？」

0x007F75.en: 「Absurd! An outcome like this could never be Heaven's will!」

0x007FBB.en: 「No. The BuJakuOh and JakuBuOh have realized it@ too - the warping of their own destiny.」

0x00801A.en: 「Are you saying they'd defy our sorcery...@　no, that they'd defy Gan Eden itself！」

0x00807F.en: 「All things flow and turn, endlessly born and@　changed and passing on. So it is with our fate, too.」

0x008102.en: 「What are you saying! WE are the guardians of@　Earth! Lords of the earthly paradise!@　Guide them through release...！」

0x00817C.en: 「Yet they turned back the great evil, the 'King@　of Ruin,' subdued the Four Fiends, and stand@　here before us.」

0x0081FF.en: 「Do you see, Jun？@　We are on this side. They are on the far side.」

0x008261.en: 「As if I could! Would you throw our dearest@　wish, the Grand Human Release Plan, to nothing！？」

0x0082C3.en: 「Even if right and wrong were reversed,@　so long as good fruit is borne, that is enough.」

0x008322.en: 「What is a sage for, if not to guide fools!@　Have you forgotten why we bowed to Gan Eden...！」

0x00839F.en: 「All is as the current wills it...@　The moment the shrine maiden found a new sword,@　our Heaven-given fate was changed.」

0x008436.en: 「Pilots of the Azure Dragon and White Tiger.@　New swords. Lend your ears to my word-soul.」

0x00849B.en: 「We die in service to Heaven's will.@　You - walk your own path.」

0x00850D.en: 「But it is a road of hardship and trial. Take heed.」

0x008578.en: 「Every will, every event, lies within the Great@　Absolute. Good, good. Fuwahahahahahaha!!」

0x0085F5.en: 「Gone... are they gone? Taihoku, Kanan... the JakuBuOh...！？」

0x008644.en: 「...Good grief, the old man takes his games too@　far. Dumping the rest on me like this.」

0x0086D7.en: 「Lovely, things are heating up.@　Time for the finale, hahahaha!!」

0x0087B6.en: 「Tch, fate really is spiteful.@　And it was such a fine way to kill the boredom.」

0x00881B.en: 「Well, it's Gan Eden that carries out the Grand@　Human Release Plan, not me...@　So I'll let you have the glory this time.」

0x0088EE.en: 「Then, since you insist,@　let me say a little more!」

0x008941.en: 「I'll open the Gate of Baral for you,@　so cling to the mercy of God!」

0x00899D.en: 「And you'll be given a most delightful role as@　gods! In your mere mortal bodies,@　not immortal ones at all!」

0x008A1E.en: 「Fighting on and on against all the demons and@　evils! Or - maybe you already are！？」

0x008A7D.en: 「In any case, destroying is easier than guarding!@　Break lives, break stars, break away, and@　tighten the noose around your own necks!」

0x008B28.en: 「Ah, but you've already done that, haven't you！@　My mistake, my mistake! Hahahahaha!」

0x008BDF.en: 「Tch, and it was such a fine way to kill the boredom.」

0x008C19.en: 「Not bad at all...@　For commoners to push the OhRyuKoh this far.」

0x008C6F.en: 「But you don't know what the Nanboku Immortals@　truly are. Taihoku, bind the OhRyuKoh with the sorcery...」

0x008CE0.en: 「The BuJakuOh and JakuBuOh have realized it too -@ the warping of their own destiny.」

0x008D36.en: 「Yet they turned back the great evil, the 'King@　of Ruin,' subdued the Four Fiends and Four@　Spirits, and stand here before us.」

0x008DC2.en: 「As if I could!@　Would you have our dearest wish, the Grand@　Human Release Plan, come to nothing！？」

0x008E96.en: 「Well, that was a truly splendid sore-loser speech.」

0x008EDF.en: 「Tch, a cocky bastard right to the very end.」

0x008F47.en: 「Abnormal gravity field forming around the ship!@　It's expanding!!」

0x008FC2.en: 「Kusuha, you're being deceived by the RyuKoOh.@　My OhRyuKoh and I are the true justice.@　To put it plainly.」

0x00905B.en: 「I won't be swayed by that man's words...！@　I believe in the RyuKoOh!」

0x0090F7.en: 「Kusuha, I'll say it as many times as it takes.@　Give yourself to me. And live out an eternity@　with me in paradise.」

0x00919C.en: 「The ones I'll live with are Bullet and everyone...@　and the RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh!」

0x00920A.en: 「I will never accept release or ascension!@　I'll fight you as a human being!」

0x009278.en: 「Hm, an unshakable resolve.@　Your experience as a protector is your foundation.@　Good, good.」

0x009333.en: 「The Four Gods' power can't defeat the OhRyuKoh.@　Well, try all you like until it's out of your system.」

0x0093A4.en: 「I'll rise above the ranks of the Machinery!@　With single-minded focus, my will and the KoRyuOh's!!」

0x009421.en: 「What Kusuha truly needs isn't you or the@　KoRyuOh... it's me.」

0x009489.en: 「Today's the last day for your delusions!」

0x0094BD.en: 「It's no delusion - it's love.@　With my love, Kusuha will bloom more beautifully.@　Yes, like a violet in a rugged valley.」

0x009553.en: 「There's a White Tiger in that valley!@　I won't let you do as you please with Kusuha!」

0x0095AF.en: 「Still as straight-hearted as ever.@　But that is why you break so easily. Take heed.」

0x00962F.en: 「Mind your own business!@　First, I'll smash that shield of yours to pieces!!」

0x00968B.en: 「Son Ganglong! Though this body perish!@　Though this life run out, I will strike you down!」

0x0096F3.en: 「...Say that, and you might vanish before you can.@　If you'll take your revenge, best be quick. Hahaha!」

0x009782.en: 「Kanan!@　I'll be your puppet no longer!」

0x0097D2.en: 「You're doomed to vanish either way,@　so make sure you've no regrets. Hehehehe.」

0x009834.en: 「You turn your blade on us. That too is good.」

0x009868.en: 「No longer will I dance in your palm!@　Pay the price for deceiving me!」

0x0098D0.en: 「Even with that mighty sword, you can't cut the OhRyuKoh, you know？」

0x009916.en: 「Then that dragon-scale! I'll pierce it and shatter it!」

0x009959.en: 「Quite an amusing bit of sophistry! Hahaha!」

0x009996.en: 「Machinery of the Vermilion Bird, and Kanan!@　Take my blade, and burn to ash in your own flame!」

0x0099FB.en: 「Hmph, before that, with the Black Serpent Blade@　I'll break your heart and your sword!」

0x009A54.en: 「One of the blood of Inago will make fine sport,@　a good way to kill the boredom. But I'll show no mercy.」

0x009AB9.en: 「No retreat - that is our way!@　And my bloodline, my pride, will cleave you in two!」

0x009B2D.en: 「And yet, for all that,@　the RyuKoOh never chose you, did it？」

0x009B80.en: 「Even so, I bear the soul-power passed down@　from my ancestors! I'll carve it into your flesh!」

0x009C03.en: 「A hollow soul and a fierce will... how unbalanced.」

0x009C40.en: 「Well, I can't let you go to my god, now can I.@　You'll die here. Best to cut off any@　future troubles.」

0x009CE5.en: 「Future troubles...！？ What's that supposed to mean!」

0x009D22.en: 「Call it hating your own kind! Hahahaha!」

0x009D5C.en: 「...Captain, this ship and the Hagane@　appear to have returned to normal space.」

0x009DD7.en: 「Confirming position... but it should be nearly@　where we were before. And every one of our@　units is intact.」

0x009E89.en: 「None so far.@　Only the Garden of Baral lies on our course.」

0x009EEE.en: 「Then, have any units needing repair or resupply land.@　Keep full perimeter alert. Once the rendezvous sequence is@　corrected, we head for the Garden of Baral.」
